display.title: Mishenichnas Adar: Three Reasons to Be Happy
display.summary_short: On the eve of Rosh Chodesh Adar, Uncle Yossi explains why we add more simchah in Adar and gives three reasons every Jew has to be happy.
display.summary_long: A short holiday talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given the night before Rosh Chodesh Adar. Uncle Yossi reminds children that serving Hashem with joy is a standing order all year long, but in one month we must add even more: 'Mishenichnas Adar marbim b'simchah', when Adar arrives we increase our happiness as much as possible, and Hashem blesses us with a happy year in return. Nor do we have to look far for reasons to be happy. First, we are Jews, each with a holy neshamah that is truly a part of Hashem. Second, we daven to Hashem alone. Third, we have the holy Torah that Hashem gave us. He ends by wishing everyone a happy Rosh Chodesh.
display.lesson: When Adar comes, add more and more simchah: be happy that you are a Jew with a holy neshamah, that you daven to Hashem alone, and that you have the Torah.
